pages.text: $(bold)Three steps from creature to organ:$(reset)$(br)$(li)Sample Collector → $(reset)Life Sample$(reset)$(li)Gene Analyzer → $(reset)Gene Sequence$(reset)$(li)Life Struct → $(reset)Organ$(reset)$(br2)$(reset)Purity$(reset) flows through the whole chain: sample purity → sequence purity → organ completeness → rejection modifier. High-purity organs require high-purity samples as the starting point; every later step keeps and drains part of that purity.

pages.title: Step 1: Sampling
pages.text: $(bold)$(item:akaishi:akaishi_sample_collector)$(reset)$(li)5,000 life energy per draw$(li)At most 3 successful draws per creature individual$(li)Weaker creatures are easier: +10% at half health, +10% more at quarter health, capped 95%$(br2)$(bold)Purity skews low:$(reset)$(li)60% chance of 0-49$(li)25% chance of 50-74$(li)15% chance of 75-100$(br2)High-health, strong-gene creatures (Ender / Boss / Dragon) give the best odds of high purity. Low-purity samples are still potion-table fuel.

pages.title: Step 2: Extraction
pages.text: $(bold)$(item:akaishi:akaishi_gene_analyzer)$(reset)$(li)Input: life samples with purity ≥25$(li)5,000 life energy, 5 seconds$(li)Success rate scales with purity: ≈70% at 25, ≈95% at 100$(li)Failure destroys the sample — treat good samples carefully$(br2)Output is a $(reset)gene sequence fragment$(reset) that keeps the source group, the exact creature and the purity. Samples below 25 purity are rejected here and only have the potion route.

pages.title: Step 3: Organ construction
pages.text: $(bold)$(item:akaishi:akaishi_life_struct)$(reset)$(li)Input: 1 gene sequence + 5 Solid Matter + 80,000 life energy$(li)6 seconds$(li)$(reset)Organ completeness = sequence purity − random loss (0-20)$(reset)$(br2)$(bold)Completeness drives rejection:$(reset) the higher the completeness, the lower the transplant rejection (up to half off) — a 90+ purity sequence is worth extra sample runs.$(br2)$(bold)Quality starts from the source group:$(reset) Warm-blooded I → Undead/Explosive/Aberrant II → Ender III → Boss/Dragon IV, attribute multiplier 1.25 → 2.0; compatibility is pulled toward the group's top range by purity.
Which genome each creature belongs to and its ranges are in The Seven Genomes. Once organs are built, how to transplant and manage rejection is on the next page — Installation & Care.
